about_short_description.short_description: Software Distribution Platform for on-prem, BYOC and customer controlled environment

product.name: Distr Software Distribution Platform
product.description: An open source platform to manage and distribute software to self-managed, BYOC, and on-premises customer environments.

product.name: Distr Artifact Registry
product.description: An OCI-compliant container and artifact registry integrated into Distr for managing and distributing software artifacts with license-based access control.

product.name: Distr Deployment Agents
product.description: Optional Docker Compose and Helm agents that manage application deployments, collect logs and metrics, and enable remote troubleshooting.

product.name: Distr Customer Portal
product.description: A web portal for customers to simplify installation, download artifacts, and monitor deployments and security vulnerabilities.

product.name: Distr Vendor Portal
product.description: A management interface for software vendors to administer customers, licenses, deployments, and access policies.
